description: 【名古屋市】津波避難ビル一覧表 [tsunami] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 名古屋市. 名古屋市内の各区の津波避難ビルの一覧です。 指定対象区域は、中村区、瑞穂区、熱田区、中川区、港区、南区、緑区の7区とし、新たに指定する施設については、津波災害警戒区域内に所在する施設（津波災害警戒区域内に宅地内の一部が所在する場合も含む）に限ります。. Coverage: 名古屋市. The portal files it under the publisher 名古屋市. Its tags are 名古屋市, 施設一覧, 津波避難ビル, 災害, 防災. It offers 7 resource(s) in xlsx. The portal shows 2025-03-03 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
